plain_english: Ear, skin, eye, tongue, nose — organs of knowing in sound and the rest; voice, hand, foot, anus, privates — organs of doing again.
sanskrit_cite: śrotraṃ tvagakṣirasanā ghrāṇaṃ buddhīndriyāṇi śabdādau | vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthaṃ karmendriyāṇi punaḥ

plain_english: Their object, to be grasped, is subtle and without divisions: the five tanmātras — sound, touch, form, taste, smell.
sanskrit_cite: eṣāṃ grāhyo viṣayaḥ sūkṣmaḥ pravibhāgavarjito yaḥ syāt | tanmātrapañcakaṃ tat śabdaḥ sparśo maho raso gandhaḥ

plain_english: From their mixture the gross object takes on five-element-ness: sky, wind, fire, water, and earth.
sanskrit_cite: etatsaṃsargavaśāt sthūlo viṣayas tu bhūtapañcakatām | abhyeti nabhaḥ pavanas tejaḥ salilaṃ ca pṛthvī ca

plain_english: As husk covers the rice-grain, creation beginning with nature covers; down to earth, consciousness wears the body.
sanskrit_cite: tuṣa iva ta.ṅdulakaṇikām āvṛṇute prakṛtipūrvakaḥ sargaḥ | pṛthvīparyanto 'yaṃ caitanyaṃ dehabhāvena

plain_english: The supreme covering! Impurity here: subtle — the Māyā-sheath; gross — the outer body-form; wrapped in three sheaths stands the self.
sanskrit_cite: param āvaraṇaṃ mala iha sūkṣmaṃ māyādikañcukaṃ sthūlam | bāhyaṃ vigraharūpaṃ kośatrayaveṣṭito hy ātmā

plain_english: Joined to darkness-ignorance, the one self, its own nature, perceives itself manifold through grasper-grasped variety.
sanskrit_cite: ajñānatimirayogād ekam api svaṃ svabhāvam ātmānam | grāhyagrāhakanānāvaicitryeṇāvabudhyeta

plain_english: As cane-juice in molasses, sugar, lumps: so every divided state of the supreme self, Śambhu.
sanskrit_cite: rasaphāṇitaśarkarikāguḍakha.ṅdādyā yathekṣurasa eva | tadvad avasthā bhedāḥ sarve paramātmanaḥ śambhoḥ

plain_english: Knower, inner ruler, breath, the all, the born — mere convention, in truth not at all.
sanskrit_cite: vijñānāntaryāmiprāṇavirāḍdehajātipi.ṅdāntāḥ | vyavahāramātram etat paramārthena tu na santy eva

plain_english: No snake in the rope, yet fear kills till death: delusion's great power no one can tell apart.
sanskrit_cite: rajjvāṃ nāsti bhujaṅgas trāsaṃ kurute ca mṛtyuparyantam | bhrānter mahatī śaktir na vivektuṃ śakyate nāma
